# Studio Genki

> Dual-practice ceramics studio and pottery school in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, offering small-batch handcrafted ceramic tableware and hands-on pottery and mixed media art classes.

## Studio Details
- **Name:** Studio Genki: Pottery Studio
- **Location:** Civil Aerodrome Post, SITRA, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641014, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 73730 74962
- **Email:** koushik@studiogenki.in
- **Website:** https://studiogenki.in/

## Classes & Workshops
- [All Classes & Workshops](https://studiogenki.in/classes.html): Overview of pottery and art courses in Coimbatore.
- [Wheel Throwing Class](https://studiogenki.in/beginners-pottery-classes-coimbatore.html): 9-session beginner wheel throwing course (8 throwing & trimming sessions + 1 glazing session), 3 hours per session, strictly capped at 3 students per slot (10 AM–1 PM or 2 PM–5 PM). Fee: ₹15,900 all-inclusive. Available on weekdays (must be completed within 20 days) or weekends (must be completed within 5 weeks). Instructor: Koushik Murali.
- [Sunday Mixed Media Art Classes](https://studiogenki.in/sunday-mixed-media-art-classes.html): Weekly 2-hour Sunday classes in Painting, Ceramic Art, and Craft for ages 10+ (Beginner to Intermediate). Kid-friendly and beginner friendly. Fee: Rs. 5,000 per month. Instructor: Karthik Subramanian (MFA, Government College of Arts, Chennai).
- [Handbuilding Workshop](https://studiogenki.in/handbuilding-workshop.html): Multi-tier handbuilding courses (Explore, Foundation, Intensive) covering pinch, coil, and slab techniques.
- [Miniature Sculpting Crash Course](https://studiogenki.in/miniature-sculpting-crash-course.html): 3-session beginner sculpting workshop with Karthik Subramanian (Completed batch).
